## Story DD Coverage
None directly — gap-analysis-derived prerequisite for tasks 2/3/4. Provides a shared paginating ACLI stub fixture so the three parallel RED test tasks do not invent divergent stub semantics.

## Testing Mode
RED

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] conftest.py defines paginating_acli_stub fixture
  Verify: test -f tests/unit/dso_reconciler/conftest.py && grep -E 'def paginating_acli_stub|@pytest.fixture.*paginating' tests/unit/dso_reconciler/conftest.py
- [ ] Fixture slices list-of-pages by start_at + max_results (matches real ACLI semantics)
  Verify: grep -E 'start_at|max_results' tests/unit/dso_reconciler/conftest.py

## Implementation Notes
- Look at existing _make_mock_acli + _PaginatingClient in tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_snapshot.py (lines 61-73, 198-212) for the pattern
- Real ACLI semantics (plugins/dso/scripts/acli-integration.py:752-796): search_issues(jql, start_at, max_results) caches full result and returns all_issues[start_at:start_at+max_results]
- Fixture signature: paginating_acli_stub(pages: list[list[dict]]) returns a context manager / fixture that patches fetcher._load_acli to return a module with an AcliClient whose search_issues respects start_at/max_results against sum(pages, [])

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: RED prerequisite: shared paginating ACLI stub fixture in conftest.py
